title: Shut up, Evil Dragon, I Don't Want to Raise A Child with You Anymore
titleEnglish: Shut up, Evil Dragon, I Don't Want to Raise A Child with You Anymore
titleRomaji: Bizui Elong Wo Bu Xiang Zai Gen Ni Dai Haizi Le
titleNative: 闭嘴恶龙我不想再跟你带孩子了
synopsis: The dragon slayer Leon was defeated and captured by the Silver Dragon Queen. With his life on the line, he tried to use forbidden magic to curse the dragon queen, but the curse had unexpected side effects, and the queen lost control as they had a one-night stand. He thought that the shame she would carry for the rest of her life would be enough to fulfill his life's purpose as a dragon slayer. But two years later, when Leon opened his eyes, he found a young dragon girl with a tail sleeping next to him…

title: Maria the Virgin Witch
synopsis: As a war to determine the rightful ruler of medieval France ravages the land, it seems that the only hope for most, is protection from the heavens above through prayer. But deep in the forest outside of a small, bucolic village, the witch Maria will not stand idly by as men kill each other and commit horrendous acts in the name of God and glory. Using her powerful magic, she'll summon various beasts and demons—even going as far as using a succubus to seduce soldiers into submission under the veil of night—all to stop the needless slaughter. However, Maria's display of her magical might has drawn the ire of the Kingdom of Heaven and after the Archangel Michael puts an end to her meddling, he curses her to lose her powers if she ever gives up her virginity. Will she forgo the forbidden fruit of adulthood in order to bring an end to the merciless machine of war? (Source: Kodansha USA)

synonyms: Hey, Wanna Go Out With Me? My Childhood Friend, a Beautiful Girl, Asked Me To Be Her Boyfriend, and I’ve Started a Camouflage Boyfriend
synopsis: Masaichi Mazono, an otaku boy, and Toiro Kurumi, the most beautiful girl in school, are childhood friends with a relaxed relationship. Toiro, tired of receiving unwanted romantic attention at school, asked Masaichi to pretend to be her boyfriend. Since they've been together all their lives, they thought it would be easy to be a fake couple, but there is no way that these childhood friends, who have such great chemistry with each other, can end up being just fake lovers... (Source: Tonari no Young Jump, translated)

title: Chihayafuru plus Kimigatame
titleNative: ちはやふる plus きみがため
synopsis: Ritsu Nagara is a new first-year member of the Mizusawa High School karuta club. For some reason, Ritsu is aiming to win the national championship, but after Chihaya and her friends graduate, the Mizusawa Karuta Club has only one A-class player, and he has a difficult time ahead of him... The story depicts Ritsu's growth along with his eccentric friend Akino and the other members of the club who are dedicated to playing karuta. (Source: Natalie, translated)
